note: Words for My journey (f10 design, 4 Nov 2026). One skill per stop; the learned lines match helpers/feedback.js. ("New words I know" was removed, Habiba, 4 Nov 2026.)
bigIdeaMore: Before, you guessed. Now you can check your guess with data.

ask.learned: A good question is clear, fair and says when.

plan.learned: A guess helps you notice surprises in the data.

collect.learned: Data is a set of answers, one from each person.

graph.learned: A graph shows how many, but not why.

number.learned: Mean, median and mode each tell a different story.
number.learnedWords: For words, the mode is the typical answer.

chance.learned: More trials usually get closer to what should happen.

conclude.learned: A claim needs proof and how sure you are.

nextTime: Ask a question about my real class.
Try a new question and compare the answers.
Say why I think something, with a number as proof.
